sentences.text: The agreement requires a 2% pre-payment charge on the principal outstanding for foreclosure or pre-payment, in full or in part.
For this case, the current RBI rule for a Tier 3 UCB, floating-rate loan, individual borrower, and non-business purpose says no pre-payment charges are permitted.
So Clause 9.3 does not comply with the RBI’s current rules because it imposes a pre-payment charge where the current rule prohibits one.
